scope: Graph Explorer search-error recovery and responsive relationship-map rendering

root_causes.behavior: A failed ingredient search left its warning visible after a later successful search or after clearing the query.
root_causes.cause: Search failures reused the page-wide error state, while the search success and empty-query paths did not clear it.

root_causes.behavior: The relationship map rendered wider than the phone viewport and could show only dots until the user horizontally panned.
root_causes.cause: The SVG kept fixed 760 by 540 graph coordinates and a 620 px minimum width, independent of its narrow container.

changes: Scoped search failures to searchError; a successful query and a cleared query remove that message without clearing unrelated graph errors.
Measure the map container with ResizeObserver, use its width and responsive height for force layout and view transforms, and remove the fixed 620 px SVG minimum width.
Added unit and headed-browser regressions for search recovery and map viewport fit.

failure_first.regression: relationship map fits its viewport without horizontal clipping
failure_first.before_fix: Failed on mobile Chromium: expected SVG width <= 357.67 px, received 620 px.

failure_first.regression: failed search followed by successful search and query clearing
failure_first.before_fix: The previous headed browser/component regression reproduced the stale search warning after successful search.

build.command: NEXT_PUBLIC_GRAPH_EXPLORER_ENABLED=true NEXT_PUBLIC_GRAPH_EVIDENCE_ENABLED=true NEXT_PUBLIC_GRAPH_RESEARCH_ENABLED=false npm run build
build.result: Passed; Next.js built 62 pages and completed type validation. Existing caniuse-lite age and edge-runtime static-generation warnings were reported.

jest.result: 214 suites passed, 1 suite skipped; 868 tests passed, 1 skipped.

headed_graph_explorer_browser.result: 18 passed, 2 expected feature-off skips across desktop Chromium and iPhone-sized Chromium. Includes live FE-to-Monolith cases with API route interception disabled.

verification.failure_first_map_regression: The mobile viewport test failed before the responsive canvas change and passed on desktop and iPhone-sized Chromium afterward.

live_api.result: HTTP 200, 25 nodes, 5 edges from the isolated local legacy seed database.

headed_manual_browser.browser: Codex in-app Chromium tab at http://localhost:3200/explore/graph, iPhone-sized viewport
headed_manual_browser.result: Live ingredient search loaded from Monolith; rendered SVG was 286 px wide inside a 286 px map container, with scrollWidth 286 px, five SVG circle layers, and two ingredient labels. The graph map was visibly rendered after the search.
headed_manual_browser.data_boundary: Local legacy API and isolated Mongo seed; not the accepted hash-pinned Leader graph artifact.

limitations: The live integration uses isolated local legacy seed data; most browser error/evidence scenarios use fixtures.
No accepted hash-pinned graph-product artifact or route is present, and this run does not establish source rights, calibrated substitution decisions, production persistence, or deployed behavior.
Backend Graph Evidence provider behavior was not enabled against a live credential; fixture cases verify client refusal and unavailable states.
